# GET /api/v1/teams/{id}/repos/{org}/{repo}

Get a particular repository of a team

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-065`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| id | path | integer (int64) | True |
| org | path | string | True |
| reponame | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**200** — *api.Repository

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `id` | int64 | repo ID |
| `name` | string | repo name |
| `permissions` | Permission | user permissions on repo |

- **404** — team not found, repo not found, or repo not in team
